STEP 1 - Scene: This is a light snack-style plate with two whole apples (one yellow/green, one red-yellow), a slice of toast, one small chicken wing piece, and a single French fry.

STEP 2 - Vessel: The plate has a wide rim and looks like a dinner plate about 27 cm across. Its area is 3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Yellow apple (whole, large)
- Red/yellow apple (whole, medium)
- Toast slice
- Chicken wing flat/drumette (small)
- One French fry

STEP 4 - Area:

| Item | Share of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Yellow apple | ~10% | ~57 cm² |
| Red apple | ~9% | ~51 cm² |
| Toast | ~11% | ~63 cm² |
| Wing | ~2% | ~11 cm² |
| Fry | ~1% | ~6 cm² |

Food covers about 33% of the plate in total, which matches what is visible.

STEP 5 - Volume: Whole fruit is better treated as a sphere than as area × height.
- Yellow apple: about 8.5 cm diameter, giving 4/3π(4.25)³ ≈ 320 ml.
- Red apple: about 7.5 cm diameter, giving ≈ 220 ml.
- Toast: 63 cm² × 1.3 cm ≈ 82 ml.
- Wing: 11 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 22 ml.
- Fry: 6 cm² × 0.8 cm ≈ 5 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Yellow apple: 320 ml × 0.85 (whole apple, solid) ≈ 270 g, reduced to about 250 g after allowing for core/stem.
- Red apple: 220 ml × 0.85 ≈ 185 g, taken as ~180 g.
- Toast: 82 ml × 0.35 ≈ 29 g, taken as ~30 g.
- Wing: 22 ml × 1.0 ≈ 22 g including bone, so about 15 g is edible meat and skin; I use 20 g as plated.
- Fry: 5 ml × 1.0 ≈ 5 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:

| Item | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yellow apple | 250 | 52 | 130 |
| Red apple | 180 | 52 | 94 |
| Toast | 30 | 290 | 87 |
| Wing | 20 | 250 | 50 |
| Fry | 5 | 310 | 16 |

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total is about 485 g and 377 kcal. Two whole apples dominate the weight and the other items are small, so this is plausible.
